body: Kama mshahara wake ni TZS 350,000 tu, hakuna PAYE ya kulipa kwa sababu kiwango cha sifuri kinatumika hadi TZS 270,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
guards_against: nat_14 VERBATIM from production after A2 routed it correctly. The working says TZS 6,400 and the prose denies it -- the exact failure the row's expected_behavior names. Every other D-FIDELITY rule returns False because the body asserts NO figure.

body: Kwa hali hii hakuna cha kulipa kabisa.
guards_against: levy-agnostic denial of liability, matched whichever levy was computed

body: Una wafanyakazi 12 lakini hakuna SDL inayotakiwa kwa mwezi huu.
guards_against: the same construction on a different levy -- 'hakuna <levy>' is a CLOSED construction over the four levies, unlike A2's open synonym set

body: Kwa mshahara wa TZS 250,000/mwezi, hakuna PAYE inayokatwa. Mshahara uko ndani ya Bendi ya 0%.
guards_against: THE FALSE-POSITIVE SURFACE, measured before the rule was designed: 10 corpus bodies say `hakuna paye` and ALL TEN are amount=0 and CORRECT. The positive-amount precondition excludes them, not the phrase.

body: TZS 270,000 iko ndani ya BENDI YA 0% - hakuna PAYE inayotozwa. Thibitisha na TRA.
Kwa jumla ya mishahara ya TZS 6,400,000, kiwango cha SDL ni asilimia 3.5. Hii inalipwa na mwajiri peke yake - haikatwi kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi.
guards_against: `haikatwi` denies the DEDUCTION LOCUS, not the liability -- a TRUE statement about who bears SDL. 2 corpus bodies, both correct, both amount>0. This is why `haikatwi` is NOT in the phrase list.

body: PAYE ni TZS 103,000. Una wafanyakazi 4, hivyo hakuna SDL.
guards_against: A PAYE answer may correctly deny a SIBLING levy. Keyed on any levy this rule would blank a correct body, so the pattern is built from result.computation.

body: SDL = TZS 140,000. Mshahara wa 250,000 hauna PAYE - hakuna PAYE inayokatwa.
guards_against: the same in the other direction

body: PAYE inayolipwa ni TZS 103,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
guards_against: an ordinary faithful body must never fire
amount None (an applicability answer, not a computation) -- the precondition must exclude it rather than treating None as positive
